name: AI chat
summary: Stream tokens from an LLM through the AI Gateway, persisting each turn

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon. Conversations and messages are persisted here so state survives isolate eviction.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon. Used for both the streaming chat call and structured generation, so no per-provider key is needed.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: AI Gateway base URL. Injected automatically by Neon. Override only to point at a different OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

env.name: CHAT_MODEL
env.description: Model id used for both /chat and /generate. Routed through the AI Gateway.

env.name: CHAT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS
env.description: Reject a prompt whose estimated input exceeds this before any model call. The endpoint is public, so this is a denial-of-service guard, not a nicety.

env.name: CHAT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
env.description: Cap on generated tokens per turn. Bounds per-invocation cost.

env.name: CHAT_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS
env.description: Hard ceiling on model to tool to model iterations in one request. Prevents a runaway agent from burning Capacity-Hours.

env.name: CHAT_HISTORY_LIMIT
env.description: Most recent turns loaded into context when no external memory is configured. Older turns are truncated, not summarized.

env.name: CHAT_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Time budget for the model stream to produce its first byte. Kept under Neon's 15-minute time-to-first-byte ceiling.

env.name: CHAT_API_KEY
env.description: Optional shared secret. When set, a request may authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer <this value>' (constant-time compared). The zero-config way to protect a public endpoint before Neon Auth is wired.

env.name: NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL
env.description: Neon Auth issuer. Injected when Neon Auth is enabled. When set, a bearer JWT is verified against its JWKS (implementation is a marked TODO seam) and the token subject scopes the conversation.

env.name: CHAT_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN
env.description: Origin echoed in CORS headers. Defaults to '*'. Set to your app origin when clients call the function directly.

env.name: RAG_URL
env.description: Base URL of the rag block (#2). When set, /chat retrieves context from it before calling the model. Unset means retrieval is skipped.

env.name: SEMANTIC_CACHE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the semantic-cache block (#20). When set, single-shot calls check the cache before the model. Multi-turn chats are not cached.

env.name: AGENT_MEMORY_URL
env.description: Base URL of the agent-memory block (#21). When set, long conversations get compacted history and turn storage from it instead of the local table.

operations.title: POST /chat
operations.description: HTTP, streaming — a chat/agent turn: optional retrieval, model call streamed as SSE, turn persisted

operations.title: POST /generate
operations.description: HTTP — prompt to a validated JSON object (structured output), cache-eligible
